text: The heating design shall be based on the winter design temperature of DP-OWNR-0002 (-4.8 degC at 88 % RH) for comfort heating and on -8 degC (DP-CASE-0007) for freeze protection and the minimum room temperatures of the process buildings; the design shall be checked at the record minimum of -11.4 degC (DP-OWNR-0003) without freezing of water piping.
